files.check.py:
from stats import median
assert median([3, 1, 2]) == 2, f"odd: {median([3,1,2])}"

assert median([5, 5, 5]) == 5, f"all same: {median([5,5,5])}"
assert median([7]) == 7, f"single: {median([7])}"
print("OK")
